samples.question: The chart shows three groups (G1, G2, G3). Each group contains exactly one red, one green and one blue rectangle, in any left-to-right order. A rectangle floats: only its vertical length counts, never its position, its top edge or its width. The short black tick marks beside the vertical axis are exactly one unit apart, so a rectangle's value is its length divided by that tick spacing. The three small squares at the top are a color key, not data. For each color, add its three values across G1, G2 and G3. Which color has the greatest total? Answer red, green or blue.
